Big C Supercenter Ladprao 1 – Bangkok, Thailand (Visited: May 2026)

Big C Supercenter Ladprao 1 is one of the largest and most popular branches of Big C in the Ladprao area. It is a reliable and practical choice for daily and weekly shopping in northern Bangkok.
Location & Access Located on Ladprao Road, near the Vibhavadi intersection. Easy to reach by car or public transport, with a large parking area available.
Pros
•	Very spacious store with a wide variety of products including fresh food, groceries, household items, electronics, and clothing.
•	Competitive prices, especially on weekly promotions and bulk items.
•	Good fresh produce section (vegetables, fruits, meat, and seafood).
•	Large food court with various dining options, including halal choices.
•	Suitable for families and long-term travelers.
•	Generally clean and well-organized.
Cons
•	Can become very crowded during peak hours (evenings and weekends), especially at the checkout counters.
•	Some sections feel a bit outdated compared to newer Big C branches.
Conclusion Big C Supercenter Ladprao 1 is a solid and practical supermarket for everyday and bulk shopping in the Ladprao area. While not the most modern or luxurious, it offers good value, variety, and convenience for budget-conscious shoppers and locals.
My Rating: 4/5 A reliable choice for practical shopping in northern Bangkok.
Recommended for travelers and residents looking for affordable prices and large selection. 🛒🇹🇭
